messages:
nina (SEO): quick huddle: we're finalizing SEO tasks for the launch + webinar. need a tight checklist covering keyword intent, JSON-LD, internal link anchors, and redirect rules. short and testable.

alex (PMM): i'll own messaging + hero H1. reminder: webinar copy must match ad creative keywords for CTR parity.

marcos (Growth): tracking ask: each registration CTA needs a hidden input for `campaign_id` + utm params. hubspot mapping required.

lee (Web): dev constraints: we need deterministic canonical rules and prefer permanent 301s for retired marketing pages. also check soft-404 patterns (title=404 vs 200).

nina (SEO): good note. also check duplicate meta titles across supporting benchmarks. we should force unique title suffixes like "— Redwood Inference".

lee (Web): sample nginx 301 snippet for legacy pages:
```nginx
location = /guides/old-inference {
  return 301 https://redwoodinference.com/webinars/production-inference-launch;
}
```

nina (SEO): schema plan: Event + FAQPage JSON-LD on webinar page, Organization markup in header, and BreadcrumbList on content hub. alex, can you draft 4-6 FAQs?

alex (PMM): dropping 5 Qs into the content doc. sample FAQ JSON-LD i'll paste in docs: 
```json
{
  "@context": "https://schema.org",
  "@type": "FAQPage",
  "mainEntity": [
    {
      "@type": "Question",
      "name": "What is low-latency LLM inference?",
      "acceptedAnswer": { "@type": "Answer", "text": "Techniques and tradeoffs for reducing response time in production inference." }
    }
  ]
}
```

marcos (Growth): internal link plan: hero page links to: benchmarks (anchor: "inference benchmarks"), private deploy guide (anchor: "private inference"), cost playbook (anchor: "reducing inference cost"). reverse links from each support back to hero with the same anchors.

nina (SEO): hreflang? not for this launch initially. but make canonical stable so future i18n can use href-lang easily.

lee (Web): sitemap: add priority 0.8 for hero, 0.6 for supports. will include lastmod in PR. also will run a staging crawl and flag any non-200s.

seo-bot: Staging crawl scheduled: 2026-05-02T07:30:00Z. Will output: 301 list, 404s, duplicate titles, meta length warnings.

nina (SEO): preflight checklist (short):
- keyword mapping per page (file: /marketing/content/launch-keywords)
- JSON-LD validated (use google/schema validator)
- 301 redirect rules in staging + PR
- canonical tags + sitemap updated
- CTA utm + hidden campaign_id sent to HubSpot
- internal anchor map added to content doc
- crawl report green from seo-bot

marcos (Growth): timeline?

nina (SEO): content drafts by 2026-04-20, dev PRs by 04-22, staging QA 04-24, deploy 04-28, webinar 05-12. if blockers raise immediately.

alex (PMM): noted. i'll sync copy with ad ops so keywords align.

nina (SEO): thanks all. keep the content doc as source of truth and paste final JSON-LD snippets into the CMS head field. :white_check_mark:
